content.title: 6 SILENT {{DEFICIENCY}} SIGNS YOUR BODY IS SENDING
facts: **Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands/feet, weakness, memory problems, and low mood.
**Iron** – Constant fatigue, pale skin, brittle nails, and shortness of breath.
**Vitamin D** – Bone pain, muscle weakness, frequent illness, and low mood in winter.
**Magnesium** – Muscle cramps, twitching, poor sleep, and irritability.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, hair loss, frequent colds, and loss of taste or smell.
**Vitamin C** – Bleeding gums, easy bruising, slow healing, and constant tiredness.
**Potassium** – Muscle weakness, cramps, irregular heartbeat, and fatigue.
